display_long_description:
Step into high-speed VR action with this immersive paddle-and-ball experience inspired by the arcade classic Danger Ball from PlayStation Worlds. In this free demo version, you’ll test your reflexes and precision against a single enemy AI in intense 1v1 deathmatch mode.

Use your head movement or controllers to guide your paddle—whichever feels more natural to you. The game is fully playable whether you're sitting or standing, indoors or outdoors. It's all about giving you the freedom to play your way.

This demo is just a glimpse into what the full version will offer. The full release will feature over 20 unique enemy types, each with their own behavior, speed, and challenge level. You'll also get to compete in a variety of futuristic arenas, each adding new twists to the gameplay.

Whether you're looking for a quick reflex workout or a competitive challenge, this demo delivers fast-paced fun that’s easy to pick up but hard to master. Perfect for all playstyles and environments—get ready to bounce into action!

Are you ready to have fun ?
